addition.item: Added bundled translations for fr-FR, de-DE, es-ES, it-IT, pt-BR, cs-CZ, nl-NL, pl-PL, ru-RU, uk-UA, ja-JP, tr-TR and zh-CN (15 locales total with en-GB and el-GR).
Completed missing Greek administrator language keys while preserving curated el-GR strings.
Rebuilt the administrator dashboard with hub-style action cards for Packages, Levels, Sections, Questions, Results and Data Tools.

fix.item: Removed answer-key leakage from exam mode HTML and answer payloads.
Exam submit now whitelists question IDs from the server-issued attempt token.
Exam timeout is enforced server-side from the attempt token instead of client POST fields.
Reserved pending exam attempts in session to prevent concurrent-tab max-attempt bypass.
Sanitized CSV exports against spreadsheet formula injection.
Added package, level and section cross-validation to question save.
Added ACL checks to question save and import/export controller actions.
Fixed Packages dashboard hub icon to a valid Joomla icon.

change.item: Moved Import / Export and Options to dedicated dashboard buttons and removed the empty Options submenu entry.
Wired custom ACL actions for packages, levels, sections, questions, results and import workflows.
Joomla native updates now target the package only (pkg_devartexams).
PHP minimum aligned to 8.3.0 across package and component metadata.

security.item: Hardened exam integrity, attempt limits, CSV export safety and administrator ACL enforcement for production use.

note.item: Public release after 1.0.2. Intermediate local builds are included here.
Active exam, submit and result pages must remain excluded from Cloudflare full page cache.
Recommended update for all DevArt Exams installations.

addition.item: Added full JSON import for DevArt Exams exports from another Joomla site.
Added support for more than four answer options per question in the administrator question form and JSON import.
Added dynamic add/remove answer controls in question editing.

fix.item: Fixed question form package filtering so levels and sections from other packages are hidden after package selection.
Added server-side validation to prevent saving a question with a level or section from a different package.

change.item: Improved production safety for Cloudflare/full-cache environments by keeping active exam and result pages no-store.
Improved import/export workflow for site-to-site question bank migrations.

note.item: Active exam runner, submit and result pages must remain excluded from full page cache.
Recommended update for production DevArt Exams installations.

addition.item: Initial stable public release of DevArt Exams for Joomla 6.
Added exam mode, learning mode, CSV import/export, results, analytics, data tools, image support and Joomla ACL foundation.

change.item: Component architecture designed specifically for Joomla 6 and PHP 8.3+.
Production installer prepared for clean installation without demo data.

security.item: Added CSRF protection, ACL enforcement, safe query construction, no-store exam headers and attempt integrity protections.
